characters.name: Hesus Christo
characters.identity: Slim young elf with pointed ears, short swept black hair, olive green tunic and cape panels, brass shoulder armour and belt, brown boots. No weapon.
characters.performance: Precise grounded elf. Walk with economical heel-to-toe strides and alternating elbows. Cast draws palms to the ribs, bends the forward knee, then delivers one economical two-palm earth strike. Impact catches the blow on a raised forearm, staggers one short step, regains balance. Defeat loses the firm front knee, sinks onto the other knee, then falls onto his right side, cape settling behind.
characters.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: production pixel-art character animation sprite atlas for a tactical role-playing game.
Input image 1 is the identity and pixel rendering reference. Repaint this SAME character into genuinely different articulated animation poses, not copies, rigid rotations, skewed cutouts, or scaled silhouettes.

Every whole character remains inside its cell, with constant body scale and planted ground baseline at 85% cell height. Frames are ordered left to right.
Row 1: six-frame walking loop, front three-quarter view facing RIGHT: left-foot contact, down, passing, right-foot contact, down, passing.
Row 2: same six-frame walking loop in RIGHT profile.
Row 3: same six-frame walking loop, back three-quarter view facing RIGHT.
Row 4: six casting frames, front three-quarter RIGHT: prepare, gather, deepest anticipation, clear hand release, follow-through, recover.
Row 5: same six casting frames in RIGHT profile.
Row 6: same six casting frames, back three-quarter RIGHT.
Row 7: six impact reaction frames, front three-quarter RIGHT: brace, struck, recoil, catch balance, recover, ready.
Row 8: six defeat frames, front three-quarter RIGHT: stagger, kneel, fall, ground contact, settle, final STILL FALLEN pose. Last frames must lie on ground, not stand or disappear.
Keep limbs anatomically connected, preserve face, costume, species, colours, accessories and appendage count. Strong dark pixel outlines, deliberate hard-edged pixel clusters, restrained highlights, no smooth gradients, blur or antialiasing. Use original sprite proportions, not taller realistic anatomy. Hands and feet visibly change pose between frames. Do not paint large spell effects that obscure the body; effects are a separate game layer.

Output canvas 1086 by 1448 pixels, 6 columns and 8 rows of 181px square cells. Keep full body contained in each cell and ground at the same 85% baseline. characters.name: Grimm Bow
characters.identity: Broad muscular purple-skinned troll, black upright mane and small cream horns/tusks, heavy rounded brass pauldrons and cuffs, ochre loincloth and plated belt, bare clawed purple feet. No bow or weapon.
characters.performance: Heavy patient troll. Walk shifts weight through broad planted feet and rolling shoulders, arms counter-swing. Cast bends both knees deeply, gathers near the belly, then opens both massive palms with shoulders following. Impact barely yields at first, then folds shoulders and catches himself. Defeat braces with one palm on ground, drops to knees, rolls heavily onto one hip and finally lies on side with one large arm extended.

characters.name: Jan Wicked
characters.identity: Pale young human man with short tousled black hair, narrow black coat and layered black armour, bright silver-white fur collar and silver piping, dark gloves and boots. No sword.
characters.performance: Quiet precise duelist. Walk narrow controlled footfalls, small opposing arm swing, coat tails lag behind steps. Cast one forearm folds across chest while wrist gathers, then a sharp open-palm release and restrained follow-through. Impact turns a shoulder into the hit, coat flares once, knees recoil. Defeat tries to stay upright, drops to one knee, supports with gloved hand, falls onto back-right side and remains still.

characters.name: Urzh
characters.identity: Huge angular charcoal-grey stoneborn, jagged rocky crest and shoulders, orange furnace glow through cracks and seams, massive rock fists, dark stone feet, brass belt detail. No weapon.

characters.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production pixel-art animation sprite sheet for an existing tactical RPG. Input image is CHARACTER IDENTITY AND PIXEL STYLE REFERENCE, not desired output layout. Preserve reference identity, proportions, face, outfit, species and colours precisely. No new equipment. CRITICAL OUTPUT: exactly SIX equal columns and EIGHT equal rows =48 separate poses, one complete character in each invisible equal square cell. Portrait canvas ratio3:4, suggested1536x2048. Truly transparent RGBA background. No labels, grid, scenery, ground or shadows. All standing frames same figure height, centered feet baseline at85%cell height; ample margins even for prone poses. Columns are animation time left to right. Row1 six-frame WALK front three-quarter facing RIGHT (left contact, down, passing, right contact, down, passing). Row2 same WALK RIGHT PROFILE. Row3 same WALK BACK three-quarter RIGHT. Row4 six-frame CAST front three-quarter RIGHT (prepare, gather, deep anticipation, clear extended-hand release, follow-through, recover). Row5 same CAST RIGHT PROFILE. Row6 same CAST BACK three-quarter RIGHT. Row7 six-frame IMPACT front three-quarter RIGHT (brace, hit, deep recoil, catch balance, recover, upright rest). Row8 six-frame DEFEAT front three-quarter RIGHT (stagger, knees buckle, fall onto side, ground contact, settle, still LYING DOWN). Final three defeat frames visibly on ground, not standing; no gore, fading or disintegration. Author distinct actual articulated anatomy: limbs bend, feet plant, shoulders and clothing overlap. Never copy and rigidly transform identical poses. Opposite legs/arms in walk. Consistent character scale throughout. Crisp polished pixel clusters, controlled palette, dark silhouette outline, warm-brass accents. HARD clean alpha edges; no ambient coloured fringe, floating particles, glow, blur, bloom, airbrush or isolated stray pixels. Forty-eight separated usable animation frames.
CHARACTER: Djonah Thaan, pale-skinned male vampire with black slicked-back widow's peak hair, red eyes, sharply pointed ears, black formal suit with tiny brass fasteners, black boots, high crimson collar and black cape lined crimson. No weapon, no hat. Preserve original reference identity.
UNIQUE PERFORMANCE: Precise little steps, cape overlaps; waits in controlled stillness, gathers fingers near chest then releases in a narrow extended-palm snap. Brief braced impact then elegant knees buckle and collapse sideways, cape draped, face and hands and boots all remain intact.
MANDATORY SAFE LAYOUT: Draw each standing character no taller than65%cell height, with20%transparent space ABOVE and15%BELOW. All six bottom-row figures MUST have at least30pixels of transparent blank space beneath them in the final canvas; never let a hand, boot, hair or cape touch the bottom edge. All prone bodies have at least20pixels blank space left/right within their own cell; not cut at right border. Set all poses small enough to preserve these blank gutters. Eight rows equally spaced, six columns equally spaced. Row3 and row6 from top all face BACK-RIGHT including final/fifth cast follow-through pose; face is visible on RIGHT side of head only. Every one of48poses completely enclosed by transparent space. This is a NEW well-spaced atlas based on original identity, do not copy any clipped source.

Input image 1 is the identity and pixel rendering reference. Repaint this SAME character into genuinely different articulated animation poses, not copies, rigid rotations, skewed cutouts, or scaled silhouettes.
Layout is strict: transparent PNG, EXACTLY SIX columns by EIGHT rows, 48 complete poses. Equal cell sizes, no gutters, no labels, no border, no background, no ground shadow. Every whole character remains inside its cell, with constant body scale and planted ground baseline at 85% cell height. Frames are ordered left to right.
Row 1: six-frame walking loop, front three-quarter view facing RIGHT: left-foot contact, down, passing, right-foot contact, down, passing.
Row 2: same six-frame walking loop in RIGHT profile.
Row 3: same six-frame walking loop, back three-quarter view facing RIGHT.
Row 4: six casting frames, front three-quarter RIGHT: prepare, gather, deepest anticipation, clear hand release, follow-through, recover.
Row 5: same six casting frames in RIGHT profile.
Row 6: same six casting frames, back three-quarter RIGHT.
Row 7: six impact reaction frames, front three-quarter RIGHT: brace, struck, recoil, catch balance, recover, ready.
Row 8: six defeat frames, front three-quarter RIGHT: stagger, kneel, fall, ground contact, settle, final STILL FALLEN pose. Last frames must lie on ground, not stand or disappear.
Keep limbs anatomically connected, preserve face, costume, species, colours, accessories and appendage count. Strong dark pixel outlines, deliberate hard-edged pixel clusters, restrained highlights, no smooth gradients, blur or antialiasing. Use original sprite proportions, not taller realistic anatomy. Hands and feet visibly change pose between frames. Do not paint large spell effects that obscure the body; effects are a separate game layer.

Output canvas 1086 by 1448 pixels, 6 columns and 8 rows of 181px square cells. Keep full body contained in each cell and ground at the same 85% baseline. Reference image 2 is ONLY the approved game animation atlas layout, pixel style and pose clarity; do not copy its blue seakin identity or water effects. Clean hard alpha edges, no ambient colour fringe or detached particles.
Character identity: Small bright-eyed forest nymph with copper-orange spiky hair and green leaf crown, pointed ears, green and ochre leafy tunic, brown root-like boots and gold belt. No weapon.
Individual performance direction: Restless airy nymph. Walk light quick alternating steps and lively arm counter-swing, not whole-body floating. Cast a low knee bend and curved upward arm sweep, opens one hand forward with the other balancing, hair leaves trail then settle. Impact recoils quickly, one foot lifts to catch balance, returns to stance. Defeat stumbles two small steps within cell, drops to knees then falls gently onto side, hair and leaf hem settle.
MANDATORY CANVAS SHAPE: tall portrait canvas, width:height ratio exactly 3:4. All 48 invisible cells must be SQUARE, six across and eight down. Do not produce a wide landscape sheet. Reference image 2 provides the exact target sheet proportions.
